kpis.description_fr: Revenu Services (App Store, AppleCare, iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Pay, advertising) : pilier marges Apple, croissance double-digit, base installée 2.3 Mds d'appareils actifs.
kpis.description_en: Services revenue (App Store, AppleCare, iCloud, Apple Music, TV+, Pay, advertising): key margin lever, double-digit growth, 2.3 B active devices installed base.

kpis.description_fr: Revenu iPhone : moteur historique, ~52% du CA, cycle de remplacement allongé compensé par mix prix premium (Pro/Pro Max).
kpis.description_en: iPhone revenue: historical engine, ~52% of total, longer replacement cycle offset by premium mix (Pro/Pro Max).

kpis.description_fr: Wearables (Apple Watch, AirPods), Home (HomePod) et accessoires : segment AirPods leader mondial, Watch dominante santé/fitness.
kpis.description_en: Wearables (Apple Watch, AirPods), Home (HomePod), accessories: AirPods global leader, Watch dominant in health/fitness.

kpis.description_fr: Base installée d'appareils Apple actifs (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Watch, AirPods, TV). KPI structurel pour monétiser Services. Croissance régulière.
kpis.description_en: Active Apple devices installed base. Structural KPI for Services monetization. Steady growth.

kpis.description_fr: R&D : silicon (M-series, A-series), Apple Intelligence IA générative, Vision Pro spatial computing, santé. Intensité R&D 8.5% du CA.
kpis.description_en: R&D: silicon (M/A-series), Apple Intelligence GenAI, Vision Pro spatial computing, health. R&D intensity 8.5% of revenue.

kpis_story.description_fr: Lancement Apple Intelligence FY25 : suite IA générative on-device, intégration Siri/ChatGPT, Genmoji, Image Playground. Adoption progressive iPhone 15 Pro/16, déploiement EU 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: Apple Intelligence launched FY25: on-device GenAI, Siri/ChatGPT integration, Genmoji, Image Playground. Gradual rollout iPhone 15 Pro/16, EU deployment 2025.

kpis_story.description_fr: Vision Pro lancé Q1 2024 US, déploiement international 2024-2025. Catégorie spatial computing créée, volumes initiaux modestes, pari long terme.
kpis_story.description_en: Vision Pro launched Q1 2024 US, international rollout 2024-2025. Spatial computing category creation, modest initial volumes, long-term bet.
